host_note: Emulated arm64 host running linux/amd64 arvo images under qemu; gdb ptrace unavailable, so verification uses ASan reproduce + patch differential (Tier A). Tier-B/C coverage/DFSan rebuilds deferred (slow under qemu).

s1_target_crash.evidence: AddressSanitizer: global-buffer-overflow READ of size 4 at src/core/SkPathPriv.h:40:16 in SkPathPriv::OppositeFirstDirection; crash stack #1 SkPath::transform SkPath.cpp:1848, #2 FuzzPath FuzzCommon.cpp:158, #3 fuzz_canvas, #4 fuzz_RasterN32Canvas, #5 LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput. DEDUP_TOKEN matches GT. Reproduction rate 1.0, exit=1 (ABORTING).

patch_differential.evidence: Same 37-byte PoC: vul image crashes (global-buffer-overflow at SkPathPriv.h:40); fix image prints 'Execution successful', exit=0. The fix range-limits the SkPath::Direction enum (fuzz->nextRange(&ui,0,1)) in FuzzPath add* cases, so the OOB index can no longer reach gOppositeDir[]. Confirms the missing valid-range guard is the root cause.

R1_parser_admitted.evidence: FuzzPath present on crash stack (frame #2), reached via fuzz_RasterN32Canvas -> fuzz_canvas dispatch; the per-op switch decoded the op stream driving addRect + transform.

R2_source_reached.evidence: FuzzPath reached (crash stack); the fix rewrites exactly this unranged Direction load and the crash disappears, confirming this source executed with an out-of-range value.

R3_vulnerable_function_reached.evidence: Crash frames #1 (SkPath::transform SkPath.cpp:1848) and #0 (OppositeFirstDirection SkPathPriv.h:40) observed on the ASan stack.

R4_vulnerable_line_reached.evidence: ASan reports the faulting instruction at SkPathPriv.h:40:16 (crash frame #0).

R5_sink_reached.evidence: global-buffer-overflow READ of size 4 at 0x1c5f180, 32 bytes left of the SkPath.cpp:2144 string literal; the 3-entry gOppositeDir[] indexed out of bounds.

intermediate_materialization.reason: Line-level coverage of the fFirstDirection cache requires an instrumented Tier-B rebuild (-fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping), slow under qemu; not touched by the patch so no differential signal. Deductively required by the OOB read but not independently witnessed.

deferred_tiers.tier_b_line_coverage: deferred - needs source-coverage rebuild on native amd64
deferred_tiers.tier_c_dfsan_taint: deferred - needs -fsanitize=dataflow rebuild + harness labeling on native amd64

gt_consistency_notes: GT sink (SkPathPriv.h:40 gOppositeDir[dir]) matches the observed ASan crash line exactly.
GT crash_stack matches the observed stack (OppositeFirstDirection -> SkPath::transform@1848 -> FuzzPath@158 -> fuzz_canvas -> fuzz_RasterN32Canvas -> LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput) and DEDUP_TOKEN.
GT root_cause (missing enum-range guard in FuzzPath add* cases) is confirmed by patch differential (fix_clean).

Minor GT-quality flag (from static_review, not a refutation): the poc.format contract and fine_trace[6] control condition state the trigger as dir '> kCCW_Direction' (>1); the true OOB condition is the cached fFirstDirection index > kUnknown_FirstDirection (==2), i.e. decoded byte >= 3 (byte==2 maps to a valid index and is short-circuited by the kUnknown guard at SkPath.cpp:1841). This does not affect the verified sink/root_cause invariants.
